newsitem.title: FRANCE: Casino underpinned by merger speculation.
newsitem.headline: Casino underpinned by merger speculation.

text.p: Shares in retailer Casino rose against the trend on Friday on persistent speculation that it may be taken over or sell its hypermarkets activities, brokers said.

Casino shares were up 0.08 percent at 246.20 francs at 1110 GMT, the third consecutive daily advance. Shares in Casino's rumoured suitor, Promodes were down 1.95 percent, the third consecutive fall. The two are viewed as the most likely merger partners in the rapidly consolidating French industry.
"We lack imagination," joked one analyst, referring to the market's dogged conviction that Casino and Promodes are next.
Privately owned Auchan this year bought out Docks de France, and this week Carrefour bought a 33 percent stake in the holding company of the Cora retail group.
